note: Jeff Davis County has a zoning ordinance (Municode Ch. 38; GOMI 2018 survey), but no zoning district layer is published as a queryable service. County site has no GIS/zoning links; qPublic parcel viewer only; Hazlehurst zoning page links no map or service; ArcGIS search for Jeff Davis zoning and parcels returned no zoning layer. Only a state-hosted parcel layer (GDITAdmin Jeff_Davis_Parcels) was found and it is not queryable.
